label: Global Paleontology Database (GPD)
description: A cloud-based interface for storing, tagging, and sharing high-resolution 3D specimen data.

features.function: Rotate, zoom, and measure specimens in a virtual space.

features.label: Embargo Status
features.function: Keep data private until publication or share it with the 'Global Community' for a Reputation bonus.

game_mechanics.crowdsourced_id: If a player can't identify a bone, they can 'Upload to Community.' An NPC expert will identify it after a 24-hour delay.
game_mechanics.data_corruption_risk: Hard drives can fail! Player must spend 'Lab Credits' on server backups.
